item.title: Her
item.description:
Who ?

Beauty

Kindness

Perseverance

Intelligence

Beauty again

Personified.

I’m so in love with her. She’s sooo perfect.

ARGHHH I LOVE HER SO MUCHHH

Sometimes tho, I feel like I’m not expressing it enough. That’s probably why I tell her that I love her everyday when I can. Cus I do. Sooo fkin much.

meri jaan. my princess.

item.title: It Hurts
item.description:
It hurts.

I never have the guts to say this directly to her. It hurt from the beginning that she didn’t love me as much as I love her. It hurt from the beginning that despite giving it my all, fate still didn’t bless me with someone who loves me the same. I thought, after the no contact break that she actually had real, deep feelings for me but it’s never love. I don’t think it’ll ever be love. I don’t think I can be enough for her definition of love.

item.title: Mine?
item.description:
Impossible to comprehend

only things that I wish to lend

are my eyes, jaan, to make you see

how beautiful I see you to be

.

A jester can’t be forced to play

this game of love, he isn’t forced to stay

an atheist once, he can’t help but pray

I don’t want anything or anything but bae

.

Un-starry nights, darkness galore

I haven’t even seen her before

didn’t even know the night in store

rather see the stars in your eyes, forevermore

.

adorn in blood, cold as the night

warmth in me couldn’t put up a fight

In her arms, it feels so light

needing her near, missing her with all my might

.

All these voices, can’t bring myself

to leave, can’t tell myself

to throw away with both hands

the only place where “me” stands

.

The only hues the sky can make

only so much my heart can take

I can’t think with so much at stake

I have to be sincere, how can I be fake?

.

and so it goes

not lows, not foes

fear hath made the mind clear

companionship or face my fear

item.title: Stuff
item.description:
It hurts so much that I can’t call her anything I want anymore. jaan, ji, princess, keerthana. I can’t say what’s on my mind.

Atleast she doesn’t know that I’m hurt.

It’s true, you can never keep choosing somebody who doesn’t choose you back. I’m sure she’s just keeping me around till either she falls in love, which is unlikely, or she moves on. I’m just gonna end up a side character.
